title: Pay government-funded parental leave to eligible employees
what: Where an employer determination is in force, the employer receives Paid Parental Leave funds from Services Australia and pays them to the employee through its payroll.

sources.title: Paid Parental Leave Act 2010
sources.quote: An employer is required to pay an instalment to a person in relation to a child if: (a) an employer determination has come into force for the employer and the person;
